items.title: A killer gets resentenced over an AI video of his victim forgiving him
items.summary: An Arizona man convicted of killing a man in a road-rage incident will be resentenced because the court was shown an AI-generated video of the victim forgiving him. The victim's sister wrote the script, in which he says they "probably could have been friends." Dexerto's post got 51K likes, a quote post reading "blow the world up" got 79K, and replies called it "actual Black Mirror behavior."
items.author: @Dexerto

post.name: Dexerto
post.text:
A killer is being resentenced after an AI video of his dead victim forgiving him was played in court

The victim’s sister wrote the script, and said they “probably could have been friends”
